Two doors. Same working system.

Child creators and adult makers

Creation Station can support kids, families, and adults. The page, the cart, the story, the products, and the promotion flow can be tailored to the creator while keeping the same simple backend.

🎨

Child Creator Path

Parent-facing language, child-safe promotion, confidence-building, creative skill development, product photos, custom creator page, and share-ready social content.

🛍️

Adult Creator Path

Adult-focused language for hobbies, handmade products, side-income ideas, simple product listings, social links, and a clean storefront-style page.

Start the Creation Station intake

First form. Then payment options.

The online form sends the signup details through Formspree. After the form is submitted, the page immediately shows Zelle, Cash App, and PayPal options.

Zelle is preferred because it helps streamline funds directly to the program so young artists can immediately access funds.
